title: finding(service-storage): two chunk uploads to one session at once can both answer 200 while the session records only one of them; the chunk door reads, appends and writes back the whole parts list
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, class (a): a lost update.**
- **reach:** the chunk door (`PUT /storage/upload/chunked/:uploadId/chunk/:chunkIndex`), driven twice concurrently (chunks 0 and 1, `Promise.all` at the registered route handlers over the in-memory store) on PR #22330's head `0342e008b0`. It was not repeated over HTTP.
- **Who produces it:** no in-repo producer uploads chunks in parallel. The SDK's `resumeUpload` is sequential, and objectui (`fff07fb`) uses only the presigned flow. An external client that parallelises chunk uploads, the common S3-style pattern, meets it.

Found by objectstack-ai/objectstack#22313's dev (`os-dev-report` on #22313, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021), `session_01WkL6Eijt432S1Y7ekb6ovQ`. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## Measured

- Both PUTs answered `200`, and `sys_upload_session.parts` kept only chunk 0 (`uploaded_chunks` 1).
- **The mechanism:** the chunk door reads the session row, adds its part to the parts list in memory, and writes the whole list back (`storage-routes.ts`). Two concurrent requests both read the old list, and the last write wins.
- **On `main` before PR #22330:** the lost part silently corrupted the progress. It also corrupted PR #22311's per-index size accounting, and with it the completion's assembly.
- **With PR #22330:** the completion is refused `409` with `details.missingChunks: [1]`, and re-sending chunk 1 recovers it. So the defect is now loud and recoverable, but a parallel uploader still pays a round trip it should not.

## Direction (for triage)

Make the part record's write atomic per chunk. For example: a conditional update keyed on the row's version, retried; a per-part row instead of one JSON list; or a driver-level append. Pin it with concurrent chunk PUTs, where every part is recorded, plus the sequential control. ⛔ No change to the completion door's guard (PR #22330).

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` 「concurrent chunk upload lost update sys_upload_session parts read-modify-write race parallel chunk PUT drops part」 gave 6 hits, none this class:
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22313 (open) is the sequential resume and re-send family;
- #22218, #22175 and #7870 are closed and other storage classes;
- #14530 and #5202 are closed and unrelated.

Dedupe words: chunk door concurrent chunk upload lost update · sys_upload_session parts read-modify-write race · parallel chunk PUT drops part record · uploaded_chunks undercount concurrent
